scientific_integrity: The four-symbol formula has an exact rational finite-arrangement proof plus a separate mathematical argument extending it to all real parameters; finite checks do not alone establish an infinite statement. Classical pairwise independence and zero entropy are credited to earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar-stationary four consecutive observations are classified; no conclusion about arbitrary four-index observations. The 2004 general multiple Fourier-sum formula may admit an earlier unindexed explicit specialization. Independent historical-priority review remains outstanding.
title: An exact fourth-block independence window for a zero-entropy toral skew shift
